messages:
mike_release: deploy-bot just blocked the canary -> prod promotion for release v1.14.2. I'm seeing the message about keystore namespace mismatch. anyone quick context?

deploy-bot: PREFLT FAIL: keystore namespace mismatch detected for service inference-gateway. staging secret path: "/keystores/keystore-staging/v1" prod secret path: "/keystores/keystore/v1". Diff may cause runtime to fail when mounted. See check id: dbf-2026-03-keystore-09.

anya_eng: ugh, this came up in staging smoke last night but flaked in the test harness. looks like an old helm values override in the canary chart set `keystore.path: keystore-staging` while prod templates expect `keystore`.

laura_ops: summary from deploy logs: kube secret exists in prod but with different key prefixes. runtime expects `keystore/public_key.pem` under the mounted secret; in staging it's `keystore-staging/pub.pem`. so mount path mismatch.

sam_devops: quick repro commands:
```
kubectl -n prod get secret inference-keystore -o yaml | yq .data
kubectl -n staging get secret inference-keystore -o yaml | yq .data
```
shows different key names.

jordan_sec: what's the blast radius? does this expose any key material or just naming?

ryan_sre: naming only, keys are identical material-wise — we verified. But the app fails at startup if path not found, causing 502s. Canary already showed a couple of restarts.

anya_eng: options: 1) rollback the canary to prior image (safe, immediate) 2) backfill prod -> staging key names (manual rename) 3) push a small shim in the startup that supports both key names (fast but needs a new image/pin).

mike_release: we have a 60-minute change window for this release. I'd prefer a non-rollback path if low risk. sam, can we do a hotpatch shim without a full rebuild?

sam_devops: simplest is to patch the deployment with an initContainer that runs `kubectl -n $NS patch secret` to copy keys into the expected names, no image build required. example: `kubectl -n prod create secret generic inference-keystore-backup --from-literal=pub.pem=$(kubectl -n prod get secret inference-keystore -o jsonpath='{.data.pub\.pem}')` then apply. small risk but reversible.

laura_ops: we should also add a preflight transform to the deploy pipeline to normalise keystore key names so this doesn't recur.

jordan_sec: hotpatch is acceptable if we 1) audit the change, 2) restrict RBAC to ops-only, 3) add the change to the release notes and CCB (compliance change log).

mike_release: decision: HOLD promotion for 15m to let ops run a test copy patch in a staging-like prod namespace (dry run). if that passes, we'll apply the patch and promote. If the patch fails or we see >2 restarts in canary, we rollback to v1.14.1. I'll pin the canary image to the previous digest for the rollback plan.

ryan_sre: I'm running the dry-run now in `prod-qa` and will post logs.

deploy-bot: note logged: action_required by mike_release. fallback plan set: rollback-image=v1.14.1@sha256:abc123...; change-window=60m.

anya_eng: when we promote, please also add a Helm values migration entry so future deploys normalize `keystore.path` (I can send a PR).

sam_devops: ops run succeeded in dry-run, initContainer copied `pub.pem` -> `public_key.pem` and container booted cleanly. no restarts observed in 10m.

laura_ops: patch scheduled to prod in 10m. will create a short runbook note and mark the release as "patch-applied-keystore-normalization" in release notes.

jordan_sec: I'll file the compliance entry and sign off on the RBAC change.

mike_release: thanks everyone. I'll unhold the deploy once ops confirms patch applied. reminder: add a release note bullet: "Fixed keystore keyname mismatch that could cause inference-gateway startup failures; applied temporary initContainer patch; follow-up Helm values normalization PR pending."

ryan_sre: patch applied to prod; canary promoted. no errors after 20m. marking as resolved. :tada:
